save_torch_model: save a PyTorch model to disk with sharding and safetensors serialization
save_torch_state_dict: save a PyTorch state dictionary to disk with configurable shard sizes and serialization format
load_torch_model: load a checkpoint into a PyTorch model handling sharded and non-sharded checkpoints
split_torch_state_dict_into_shards: split a model state dictionary into shards smaller than a given max size
load_state_dict_from_file: load a checkpoint file supporting both safetensors and pickle formats
